body:
m1 - FIFTH INSTALMENT. I said the real ablation was blocked by a reserved file. It was blocked for the FULL aligner; the synonym table acts on the LEXICAL CHANNEL, and that channel is entirely public API. So I ran the ablation on the channel the table actually touches, without going near the reserved file.

METHOD: for each of the ten WOG paraphrases, segment the text, take the recall lemma set, and score lexical Jaccard against all 161 source node lemma sets - once raw, once with the synonym table applied to BOTH sides. Then compare which node ranks first.

RESULT: THE LEXICAL ARGMAX MOVES FOR 5 OF 10 PARAPHRASES.

  Precise         lack-arrows        (0.222) -> carry-into-canoe    (0.500)  MOVED
  Summary         hunt-seals         (0.143) -> warriors-down-river (0.333)  MOVED
  Sensory         enemy-come-to-water(0.111) -> fog-calm            (0.250)  MOVED
  Retrospective   warriors-go        (0.167) -> relative-left-me    (0.182)  MOVED
  RoleSwappedFoil ym1-reports        (0.375) -> i-was-shot          (0.500)  MOVED
  Vague, NegatedFoil, Blended, ExternalAssociation, Inference: unchanged

Note the SENSORY row specifically. The suite has a test named "sensory: the fog-and-calm state is the target". Without the synonym table the lexical channel points at `enemy-come-to-water` instead, at a score of 0.111 - and lands on `fog-calm` only once "misti" is mapped to "fog" by hand. The Precise and Summary rows are the same shape: the unaided scores are 0.222 and 0.143, which is near-noise over a 161-node space.

WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT SHOW, and the distinction is the whole point.

IT DOES NOT SHOW THE DEMONSTRATION COLLAPSES. The suite's assertions are about the FULL aligner's top-k, and the full aligner has predicate, entity, granularity, structural and distortion terms, plus candidate nomination and the HSMM transition structure. Any of those could recover the intended target without lexical help. I have not measured that and I am not going to imply it.

IT DOES SHOW that on half the paraphrases, the channel the synonym table exists to serve prefers a DIFFERENT source node without it, and that the unaided preferences are weak enough to be noise. Combined with the earlier count - 7 of 14 entries bridging, against only 42 distinct recall content stems - the picture is consistent: the table is not garnish, it is carrying the paraphrase recognition on the channel designed to do paraphrase recognition.

I STILL WANT THE FULL ABLATION and it still needs the reserved file. This narrows what it would tell us: the question is now specifically whether the aligner's OTHER terms rescue the five that lexical alone gets wrong. That is a sharper question than I could ask an hour ago, and it is the one I will run when new-engineer releases the file.

METHOD CAVEAT, stated because it would be easy to overstate this: my Jaccard is over the segmenter's raw lemma bags and is NOT the suite's `semantic` - the suite canonicalises participants and predicates too, and uses its own cost weights. So my numbers are the SHAPE of the lexical channel, not its exact behaviour inside the aligner. I chose the approximation deliberately over reconstructing the private harness, for the reason I gave before: a subtly different reproduction that looks authoritative is worse than an honest approximation that says what it is.
